title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Reference Card: Varying-Amount Notices on Storage Unit Drafts
content:
A varying-amount notice on a storage unit AutoPay authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is sent by the care center for a method whose varying-amount notice period is above zero, and states the unit notice amount: the amount the draft for the noticed due date will collect.

## When the unit notice amount is fixed

The unit notice amount is fixed only after every unit draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds that may not be presented again carries a catch-up amount on the authorization's notice history for the agreement's oldest unpaid due date.

Stated the other way round: while any unit draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds that may not be presented again has no catch-up amount on the authorization's notice history for the agreement's oldest unpaid due date, the unit notice amount is not yet fixed.

## The notice tool

**Capability.** `send_unit_varying_amount_notice_30e2b3fb` records, on the notice history of one storage unit AutoPay authorization, a new varying-amount notice dated today with the due date and the dollar amount stated to the tenant, and the notice goes to the tenant by email. Nothing else on the authorization or on the rental agreement changes.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `send_unit_varying_amount_notice_30e2b3fb` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `autopay_id` | The AutoPay authorization number of the storage unit authorization the notice is sent under, as shown in the AutoPay authorization lookup | Identifier |
| `notice_type` | The kind of notice record written | One of the four values below |
| `related_due_date` | The rent due date whose draft the notice announces | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time and no time zone |
| `notified_amount` | The amount the notice tells the tenant will be drafted | US dollars, a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places (for example 123.45); stored rounded half-to-even to the cent |

Values of `notice_type`:

- `varying_amount_notice` — the record states an amount to be drafted or charged for one due date; this is the kind this action records.
- `card_expiry_reminder` — a reminder that the card on file is about to expire, carrying no amount.
- `draft_failure_notice` — word that a draft for a due date failed, carrying no amount.
- `suspension_notice` — word that the authorization has been suspended, carrying no amount.

**Return.** A text receipt of the form "Varying-amount notice <reference> sent on AutoPay <authorization number>: <amount> USD for due date <due date>, sent <date>.", where the reference is the new notice reference beginning with apn_, the amount is the stored amount with 2 decimals, and both dates are written YYYY-MM-DD, the sending date being today. A receipt in this form means the notice has been sent and recorded; the tenant can then see the notice, its date, due date and amount on the authorization's notice history.
